title: Adapting prior-data fitted networks for tabular anomaly detection
title_zh: 为表格数据异常检测适配先验数据拟合网络

paragraphs.en: While deep features have transformed anomaly detection in images and video, their impact on tabular data has been less substantial, partly due to the limited availability of strong deep representations. Recently, prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) have emerged as a promising source of such representations for tabular data. In this work, we investigate how PFN representations can be adapted and leveraged for anomaly detection.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管深度特征已经改变了图像和视频中的异常检测，但它们在表格数据上的影响却相对有限，部分原因在于强大的深度表示难以获得。 最近，先验数据拟合网络（PFNs）已成为为表格数据提供此类表示的一种有前景的方法。 在本研究中，我们探讨了如何将 PFN 表示进行适配并利用其进行异常检测。

paragraphs.en: The question is harder than it looks. No anomalies are available before deployment, so model parameters cannot be tuned with supervision, and the reference set that defines normal behavior may itself contain the very anomalies it is supposed to reveal. We begin our study using frozen TabPFN features. Scoring each sample by its distance to its nearest neighbors in feature space already gives strong results. We identify which layers to use and a feature-extraction procedure suited to the task. Next, to further improve performance, we use the reference set to fine-tune the model, so that the resulting features better separate normal samples from anomalies. On the ADBench benchmark, our fine-tuning free approach (ZEN) reaches a higher mean AUROC than every baseline, and our fine-tuned method (FOCUS) improves on it further. Our approach also generalizes across PFN models 1 1 1 Code: github.com/Maximilianb1/zen-focus-tabular-anomaly-detection .
paragraphs.zh: 这个问题比看起来更复杂。 部署前没有可用的异常数据，因此无法通过监督方式调整模型参数，而定义正常行为的参考集本身可能恰恰包含了它本应检测出的异常。 我们的研究首先使用冻结的 TabPFN 特征。 仅通过计算每个样本在特征空间中到最近邻的距离进行评分，就已经能获得很好的结果。 我们确定了需要使用的层以及适合该任务的特征提取流程。 接下来，为了进一步提升性能，我们利用参考集对模型进行微调，使生成的特征能更好地区分正常样本和异常样本。 在 ADBench 基准测试中，我们的无需微调的方法（ZEN）的平均 AUROC 高于所有基线方法，而我们的微调方法（FOCUS）在此基础上进一步提升了性能。 我们的方法还能在不同 PFN 模型之间实现良好的泛化能力 1 1 1 代码：github.com/Maximilianb1/zen-focus-tabular-anomaly-detection 。

paragraphs.en: Tabular data is the most common data format in real-world machine learning ( Hollmann et al., 2023 ) . This paper studies anomaly detection on tabular data, one of the oldest tasks in the field and still one of its most active ( Han et al., 2022 ; Yoon et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . The task is unsupervised: a detector receives a reference set of samples that describe normal behavior, and must score how strongly each new sample deviates from them. High scores should single out samples such as fraudulent transactions, unusual patient records, or compromised network traffic. The detector faces two unknowns at once. First, the anomalies: they are rare and their structure is unknown in advance, which is why the task cannot be posed as supervised classification. Second, the reference set: it may itself be contaminated, as when fraud investigators can verify only a small fraction of transactions and the unverified rest enter the historical record as normal ( Dal Pozzolo et al., 2018 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 表格数据是现实世界机器学习中最常见的数据格式（Hollmann 等人，2023）。 本文研究了表格数据中的异常检测问题，这是该领域最古老的任务之一，至今仍是其最活跃的研究方向之一（Han 等人，2022；Yoon 等人，2026；Li 等人，2026）。 这项任务属于无监督学习：检测器会接收一个描述正常行为的参考样本集，并必须为每个新样本评分，以衡量其偏离这些样本的程度。 高分应能识别出诸如欺诈交易、异常患者记录或受攻击的网络流量等样本。 该检测器需要同时应对两个未知因素。 首先是异常本身：它们十分罕见，且其结构事先未知，因此这项任务无法被表述为有监督分类问题。 其次是参考样本集：它本身可能已被污染，例如在欺诈调查中，调查人员只能验证一小部分交易，而未验证的其余交易则作为正常数据进入了历史记录（Dal Pozzolo 等人，2018）。

paragraphs.en: We therefore study two settings. Our main setting is the contaminated regime , where the reference set contains anomalies at an unknown rate and nothing removes them before a detector sees it. The clean regime , where the reference set is anomaly-free but unlabeled, is the complementary setting.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们研究了两种情况。 我们的主要情况是受污染机制，即参考集以未知比例包含异常，并且在检测器观察到这些异常之前没有任何方法可以将其移除。 干净机制则是其互补情况，此时参考集没有异常，但未被标注。

paragraphs.en: Existing detectors handle these unknowns only partly. Detectors that excel on a clean reference set can degrade sharply once anomalies enter it ( Marszałek et al., 2026 ) , because an anomaly already in the reference set makes the test anomalies that resemble it look normal. Classical detectors remain remarkably strong ( Liu et al., 2008 ; Zhao et al., 2019 ) , but every deployment starts from zero, with nothing carried over. Deep methods learn richer representations ( Livernoche et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Dai et al., 2025 ) , but they too train one model per dataset, and their gains have not proven robust across datasets. The ADBench benchmark study reached a sobering conclusion: no unsupervised detector in its comparison came out reliably better than the others, “emphasizing the importance of algorithm selection” ( Han et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现有的检测器仅能部分处理这些未知因素。 在干净参考集上表现出色的检测器，一旦异常数据进入该参考集，其性能可能会急剧下降（Marszałek 等，2026），因为参考集中已有的异常会使与之相似的测试异常看起来像是正常的。 经典检测器仍然表现出显著的强效性（Liu 等，2008；Zhao 等，2019），但每次部署都需从头开始，没有任何成果可以延续。 深度学习方法能够学习更丰富的表示（Livernoche 等，2024；Yin 等，2024；Li 等，2025；Dai 等，2025），但它们同样会为每个数据集单独训练一个模型，且其性能提升尚未在不同数据集中得到验证的稳健性。 ADBench 基准研究得出了一个令人警醒的结论：在比较中，没有任何一种无监督检测器能可靠地优于其他方法，“这凸显了算法选择的重要性”（Han 等，2022）。

paragraphs.en: Anomaly detection in images solved a similar problem through transfer : over the last decade it was rebuilt on representations reused from models pretrained once at scale ( Yosinski et al., 2014 ; Bommasani et al., 2021 ) . Features taken from generically pretrained networks and scored by simple k k -nearest-neighbor distance outperformed elaborate self-supervised detectors ( Bergman et al., 2020 ) , and the same kind of features now underlies state-of-the-art industrial defect detection ( Cohen and Hoshen, 2020 ; Roth et al., 2022 ) . Tabular data could not follow this path, lacking comparably strong generic representations ( Grinsztajn et al., 2022 ; Shwartz-Ziv and Armon, 2022 ) . PANDA, an image anomaly detection method, names the absence of generic extractors for some data modalities as the main limitation of its approach ( Reiss et al., 2021 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 图像中的异常检测通过迁移学习解决了类似的问题：在过去十年中，该方法基于从大规模预训练模型中重复使用的表示重新构建（Yosinski 等，2014；Bommasani 等，2021）。 从通用预训练网络中提取并通过简单的 k 近邻距离进行评分的特征，其表现优于复杂的自监督检测器（Bergman 等，2020），而同类特征如今已成为工业缺陷检测最先进方法的基础（Cohen 和 Hoshen，2020；Roth 等，2022）。 表格数据无法遵循这一路径，因为它缺乏同样强大的通用表示（Grinsztajn 等，2022；Shwartz-Ziv 和 Armon，2022）。 PANDA 是一种图像异常检测方法，它将某些数据模态缺乏通用提取器视为其方法的主要局限性（Reiss 等，2021）。

paragraphs.en: Recently, prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), with TabPFN chief among them, have emerged as strong pretrained models for tabular data, and as a potential candidate feature extractor. These models are transformers pretrained on synthetic tabular data ( Hollmann et al., 2023 ; Hollmann et al., 2025 ; Grinsztajn et al., 2026 ) , and they match or beat strong tuned baselines on supervised tabular prediction ( Hollmann et al., 2025 ) . They work by in-context learning: given a new table as context, they predict for query samples in a single forward pass, with no dataset-specific training.
paragraphs.zh: 最近，基于先验数据拟合的网络（PFN），尤其是其中的 TabPFN，已成为表格数据的强大预训练模型，并有望作为潜在的特征提取器。 这些模型是在合成表格数据上预训练的 Transformer（Hollmann et al., 2023; Hollmann et al., 2025; Grinsztajn et al., 2026），在监督式表格预测任务中，其性能与强大的调优基线模型相当甚至更优（Hollmann et al., 2025）。 它们通过上下文学习发挥作用：给定一个新表格作为上下文，它们可以在单次前向传播中直接对查询样本进行预测，而无需针对特定数据集进行训练。

paragraphs.en: Here, we ask how such a model can best be leveraged for tabular anomaly detection. So far, PFN-based work on the task has taken two routes. One pretrains a dedicated in-context detector on synthetic anomaly-detection tasks ( Marszałek et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2026 ) . The other keeps TabPFN frozen and uses it as a plug-in scorer over its predictions ( Prior Labs, 2025 ; Ding et al., 2026 ) . Adapting a pretrained PFN to the task itself remains mostly unexplored, although adaptation of PFNs has shown some success for supervised learning ( Feuer et al., 2024 ) . Notably, adaptation is especially interesting as a detector built by adapting TabPFN would inherit future improvements of the PFNs. Moreover, PFNs are never pretrained to find anomalies, so adapting one also measures how much its representations carry beyond their pretraining objective. This raises the question we study: can a general-purpose tabular foundation model be adapted into a competitive anomaly detector?
paragraphs.zh: 在此，我们探讨如何最好地利用此类模型进行表格异常检测。 迄今为止，基于 PFN 的该任务研究已沿两条路线展开。 一条路线是在合成异常检测任务上预训练一个专用的上下文内检测器（Marszałek 等，2026；Shen 等，2025；Ding 等，2026）。 另一条路线则是保持 TabPFN 冻结，并将其作为插件评分器用于其预测结果（Prior Labs，2025；Ding 等，2026）。 将预训练的 PFN 适配到该任务本身的研究仍基本未被探索，尽管 PFN 的适配在监督学习中已显示出一定成效（Feuer 等，2024）。 值得注意的是，这种适配尤其具有吸引力，因为通过适配 TabPFN 构建的检测器将继承 PFN 未来的改进成果。 此外，PFN 从未被预训练用于发现异常，因此对其适配也能衡量其表示在预训练目标之外还包含了多少信息。 这引出了我们所研究的问题：一个通用表格基础模型能否被适配成一个具有竞争力的异常检测器？

sents.en: Notably, adaptation is especially interesting as a detector built by adapting TabPFN would inherit future improvements of the PFNs.
sents.zh: 值得注意的是，这种适配尤其具有吸引力，因为通过适配 TabPFN 构建的检测器将继承 PFN 未来的改进成果。

sents.en: Moreover, PFNs are never pretrained to find anomalies, so adapting one also measures how much its representations carry beyond their pretraining objective.
sents.zh: 此外，PFN 从未被预训练用于发现异常，因此对其适配也能衡量其表示在预训练目标之外还包含了多少信息。

sents.en: This raises the question we study: can a general-purpose tabular foundation model be adapted into a competitive anomaly detector?
sents.zh: 这引出了我们所研究的问题：一个通用表格基础模型能否被适配成一个具有竞争力的异常检测器？

paragraphs.en: This paper shows the answer is yes. We reach it in two steps that adapt TabPFN, first without changing its weights and then by updating them (Figure 1 ). First, ZEN ( Zero-training Embedding Neighbors ) scores a test sample by its distance to its nearest neighbors in the frozen model’s embedding space. We develop a feature-extraction procedure suited to the task and weight each reference sample by how much it can be trusted, so the score stays reliable even when the reference set is contaminated. Second, FOCUS ( Fine-tuned One-Class Unsupervised Scoring ) fine-tunes the model so that its features better separate the normal data from anomalies. Our evaluation for the contaminated settings finds that ZEN already reaches a higher mean AUROC than every baseline in our comparison, and FOCUS the highest of all.
paragraphs.zh: 本文表明答案是肯定的。 我们通过两个步骤实现这一目标，这两个步骤对 TabPFN 进行了调整：首先在不改变其权重的情况下进行调整，然后更新其权重（图 1）。 首先，ZEN（零训练嵌入邻居）通过测试样本与冻结模型嵌入空间中最近邻的距离为其打分。 我们开发了一种适合该任务的特征提取流程，并根据每个参考样本的可信度对其赋予相应权重，从而确保即使参考集受到污染，得分仍能保持可靠。 其次，FOCUS（微调单类无监督评分）对模型进行微调，使其特征能更好地将正常数据与异常数据区分开来。 在受污染场景下的评估结果表明，ZEN 的均值 AUROC 已经高于我们比较中的所有基线方法，而 FOCUS 的表现则最为出色。

paragraphs.en: We introduce ZEN, a training-free anomaly detector on frozen TabPFN embeddings whose score stays reliable even when the reference set is contaminated (Sec. 2.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 ZEN，一种无需训练的异常检测器，它基于冻结的 TabPFN 嵌入，即使参考集受到污染，其得分仍能保持可靠（第 2.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: We propose FOCUS, which builds on ZEN: a trust-weighted compactness fine-tune of TabPFN that reaches the highest mean AUROC in both regimes (Secs. 2.3 and 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 FOCUS，它基于 ZEN：这是一种对 TabPFN 进行信任加权紧凑性微调的方法，在两种模式下均实现了最高的平均 AUROC（第 2.3 节和第 3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Our approach is not tied to a single PFN model: applied without any change to four other tabular foundation models, it improves each of them significantly (Sec. 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法并不局限于单一的 PFN 模型：将其直接应用于另外四个表格基础模型且无需任何修改，即可显著提升每个模型的性能（第 4 节）。

paragraphs.en: While this integral is intractable, a PFN approximates it: synthetic datasets are sampled from the prior, and the network is trained to predict each dataset’s held-out labels from the rest of that dataset (Appendix D.1 states the objective). Pretraining happens once; every new table afterwards is handled in context. TabPFN uses a synthetic prior built on structural causal models, and it matches or beats strong tuned baselines ( Hollmann et al., 2023 ; Hollmann et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这个积分难以计算，但一个 PFN 可以对其进行近似：从先验分布中采样合成数据集，然后训练该网络，使其根据每个数据集的其余部分预测其预留的标签（目标函数见附录 D.1）。 预训练只需执行一次；之后每张新表都会在当前上下文中处理。 TabPFN 使用基于结构因果模型构建的合成先验，并且其表现与强大的微调基线模型相当甚至更优（Hollmann 等人，2023；Hollmann 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Beyond its predictions, TabPFN, like any transformer, computes an internal representation of every sample it processes, which we use in this work. Because it is an in-context model, every embedding depends on the whole reference set. In addition, TabPFN embeds a sample differently depending on whether it is provided as context or used as a query. We therefore embed each reference sample as a query against the rest of the set, leave-one-fold-out, following Ye et al. (2025) . Appendix D.1 gives the details, and the labels used for TabPFN’s context.
paragraphs.zh: 除了其预测结果之外，TabPFN 与任何 transformer 模型一样，都会计算其所处理的每个样本的内部表示，而我们在本研究中正是利用了这些表示。 由于它是一种上下文内模型，每个嵌入都依赖于整个参考集。 此外，TabPFN 会根据样本是作为上下文提供还是作为查询使用，对其进行不同的嵌入处理。 因此，我们遵循 Ye et al. (2025) 的方法，将每个参考样本作为查询，与参考集中的其余部分进行“留一折”嵌入处理。 附录 D.1 提供了相关细节以及 TabPFN 上下文所使用的标签。

paragraphs.en: The anomaly detection setting we study provides an unlabeled reference set D train = { x i } i = 1 n ⊂ ℝ d D_{\mathrm{train}}=\{x_{i}\}_{i=1}^{n}\subset\mathbb{R}^{d} , assumed mostly normal. It is evaluated on a test set D test D_{\mathrm{test}} composed of normal samples and anomalies. A detector assigns each test sample a score s ⁡ ( x ) s(x) , oriented such that higher means more anomalous. Ground-truth labels are used only for evaluation. The two regimes we investigate differ in one assumption about D train D_{\mathrm{train}} : in the clean regime it contains no anomalies, and in the contaminated regime it contains anomalies at an unknown rate. paragraphs.en: ZEN uses the embedding space exactly as pretraining left it. Yet, that space is shaped for supervised prediction on synthetic tasks, not for separating the normal samples of a given dataset from its anomalies. Image anomaly detection faced the same situation and moved past its frozen baselines by adapting pretrained features to the normal training data ( Reiss et al., 2021 ; Reiss and Hoshen, 2023 ; Cohen and Avidan, 2022 ) . FOCUS brings this adaptation to TabPFN. Following the fixed-center convention of DeepSVDD and PANDA ( Ruff et al., 2018 ; Reiss et al., 2021 ) , it fine-tunes the last blocks of the model such that the last layer embeddings of the reference set contract toward a fixed center c c , the trust-weighted mean of the frozen model’s final-block embeddings of that set. Under contamination the reference set contains anomalies, so the trust weights enter the loss: each reference sample pulls toward the center in proportion to how much it can be trusted (according to the weights explained in Soft cleaning above). The weights and center are computed once from the frozen model and never updated. We write ψ θ \psi_{\theta} for the fine-tuned extractor. Appendix D.1 gives the loss and every detail of the fine-tune, and Appendix C.7 ablates its constants.
paragraphs.zh: ZEN 完全按照预训练时的状态使用嵌入空间。 然而，该空间是为合成任务上的监督预测而构建的，而非用于将给定数据集的正常样本与其异常样本区分开来。 图像异常检测也曾面临同样的问题，通过将预训练特征适配到正常训练数据中，从而突破了其固化的基线（Reiss et al., 2021; Reiss and Hoshen, 2023; Cohen and Avidan, 2022）。 FOCUS 将这种适配方法引入 TabPFN。 遵循 DeepSVDD 和 PANDA 的固定中心惯例（Ruff et al., 2018; Reiss et al., 2021），它会对模型的最后几层进行微调，使得参考集的最后一层嵌入向一个固定中心 c_c 收缩；该中心是冻结模型对该集合的最终块嵌入的置信加权平均值。 在存在污染的情况下，参考集会包含异常样本，因此置信权重会被引入损失函数：每个参考样本都会按照其可信度（根据上文“软清洗”部分解释的权重）向中心靠拢。 权重和中心仅从冻结模型中计算一次，且永不更新。 我们将微调后的提取器表示为 ψ_θ。 附录 D.1 给出了损失函数以及微调的所有细节，附录 C.7 则对其中的常数进行了消融分析。

paragraphs.en: Adapting pretrained features to the normal data can collapse them. DeepSVDD avoids the collapse by constraining the network and fixing the center ( Ruff et al., 2018 ) . PANDA reports that naive adaptation often deteriorates the features and counters it with early stopping combined with a regularizer ( Reiss et al., 2021 ) . Anomaly detection provides no labeled validation set that would allow us to decide how to regularize the compactness finetuning in a supervised manner. Here we take a simpler route: FOCUS trains for two epochs on every dataset and averages the weights saved after the first and after the second epoch, in the spirit of stochastic weight averaging ( Izmailov et al., 2018 ) . No further regularization is added. Once adapted, the fine-tuned model replaces the frozen one in every step of ZEN, using the same feature subsets, the same contexts, and the same soft-cleaned readout. We call the resulting method s FOCUS s_{\mathrm{FOCUS}} .
paragraphs.zh: 将预训练特征适配到正常数据中可能会导致其坍缩。 DeepSVDD 通过约束网络并固定中心来避免这种坍缩（Ruff 等，2018）。 PANDA 指出，简单的适配通常会劣化特征，因此它采用提前停止并结合正则化器来应对这一问题（Reiss 等，2021）。 异常检测没有提供带标签的验证集，这使得我们无法以监督方式决定如何对紧凑性微调进行正则化。 此处我们采取更简单的方法：FOCUS 在每个数据集上训练两个周期，并对第一个和第二个周期后保存的权重取平均值，这一方法体现了随机权重平均的思想（Izmailov 等，2018）。 没有添加任何进一步的正则化。 适配完成后，微调后的模型将在 ZEN 的每一步中取代冻结模型，并使用相同的特征子集、相同的上下文以及相同的软清洗读输出。 我们将由此得到的方法称为 FOCUS s_{\mathrm{FOCUS}}。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on all 47 classical tabular datasets of the ADBench benchmark ( Han et al., 2022 ) . They span 80 to 619,326 samples and 3 to 1,555 features (Appendix B.1 ). In the clean regime the training data (reference set) takes 70% of the normal samples and the test set holds the remaining normals and every anomaly, according to the one-class convention ( Ruff et al., 2018 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . In the contaminated regime a stratified 70/30 split preserves the anomaly rate on both sides, as in ADBench. Datasets above 10,000 samples are first subsampled to 10,000, stratified and without replacement. We also note a leak in the official pipeline, which duplicates the samples of the twelve datasets with fewer than 1,000 samples before the split, so that most test samples there have a twin in the training set. We fix that and evaluate these datasets at their natural size instead (Appendix A.2 ). Features are scaled to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] by a MinMax scaler fitted on the training split, identically for every method. Seeds 0 through 4 were fixed in advance, and each seed draws a fresh split. Appendix A gives the protocol in full.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 ADBench 基准测试（Han et al., 2022）的全部 47 个经典表格数据集上进行评估。 这些数据集的样本数量从 80 到 619,326 不等，特征数量从 3 到 1,555 不等（附录 B.1）。 在干净数据场景下，训练数据（参考集）包含正常样本的 70%，而测试集则包含其余的正常样本以及所有异常样本，这遵循单类别方法的传统做法（Ruff et al., 2018；Li et al., 2025）。 在污染数据场景下，采用分层 70/30 划分可保持两侧数据集的异常率一致，与 ADBench 的做法相同。 样本数超过 10,000 的数据集会先被子采样至 10,000 个样本，并进行分层无放回抽样。 我们还注意到官方流程中存在一个数据泄露问题：在划分之前，该流程会重复处理样本数少于 1,000 的十二个数据集的样本，导致这些数据集的大部分测试样本在训练集中都有对应的副本。 我们修复了这一问题，并转而以这些数据集的自然规模进行评估（附录 A.2）。 特征通过 MinMax 缩放器缩放到 [−1, 1] 区间，该缩放器基于训练集划分进行拟合，且所有方法均采用相同处理方式。 种子值 0 到 4 已预先固定，每个种子都会生成一次新的数据划分。 附录 A 完整介绍了评估协议。

sents.en: We also note a leak in the official pipeline, which duplicates the samples of the twelve datasets with fewer than 1,000 samples before the split, so that most test samples there have a twin in the training set.
sents.zh: 我们还注意到官方流程中存在一个数据泄露问题：在划分之前，该流程会重复处理样本数少于 1,000 的十二个数据集的样本，导致这些数据集的大部分测试样本在训练集中都有对应的副本。

sents.en: We fix that and evaluate these datasets at their natural size instead (Appendix A.2 ).
sents.zh: 我们修复了这一问题，并转而以这些数据集的自然规模进行评估（附录 A.2）。

sents.en: Features are scaled to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] by a MinMax scaler fitted on the training split, identically for every method.
sents.zh: 特征通过 MinMax 缩放器缩放到 [−1, 1] 区间，该缩放器基于训练集划分进行拟合，且所有方法均采用相同处理方式。

sents.en: Seeds 0 through 4 were fixed in advance, and each seed draws a fresh split.
sents.zh: 种子值 0 到 4 已预先固定，每个种子都会生成一次新的数据划分。

paragraphs.en: The comparison covers the 13 classical and deep detectors that ADBench itself benchmarks through PyOD ( Han et al., 2022 ; Zhao et al., 2019 ) . To these we add recent detectors with public code: TCCM ( Li et al., 2025 ) , DTE ( Livernoche et al., 2024 ) , the official unsupervised TabPFN extension ( Prior Labs, 2025 ) , and a TabPFN pseudo-labeling control (pseudo-labels are assigned using a PCA-based anomaly score). No method, ours included, is tuned per dataset: baselines run with their authors’ recommended settings, ours with one fixed configuration per regime. Every number is computed by us under this protocol; Appendix D gives every configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 该比较涵盖了 ADBench 本身通过 PyOD（Han et al., 2022；Zhao et al., 2019）基准测试的 13 种经典和深度检测器。 在此之外，我们还加入了具有公开代码的最新检测器：TCCM（Li et al., 2025）、DTE（Livernoche et al., 2024）、官方的无监督 TabPFN 扩展（Prior Labs, 2025），以及一个 TabPFN 伪标签控制（伪标签基于 PCA 异常分数进行分配）。 包括我们的方法在内，没有任何一种方法针对每个数据集进行单独调优：基线方法使用其作者推荐的设置运行，而我们的方法则对每种模式采用一种固定的配置。 在此协议下，所有数值均由我们计算得出；附录 D 列出了所有配置。

paragraphs.en: Methods that perform very well in the clean regime often perform much worse under contamination. Table 1 shows the pattern in each method’s two regime columns. The nearest-neighbor detectors suffer the most: raw-feature k k NN loses 11 AUROC points, and LOF loses 17. Isolation Forest degrades far less and becomes the strongest baseline. Our methods sit above it. ZEN, our training-free version, reaches a higher mean AUROC than every baseline, 3.3 points above Isolation Forest ( p = 0.02 p=0.02 ). FOCUS improves on ZEN by a further 0.3 points and reaches the highest mean AUROC of all methods, 3.6 points above Isolation Forest ( p = 0.01 p=0.01 ) and 6.1 above raw-feature k k NN ( p = 0.02 p=0.02 ). ZEN and FOCUS also hold the two best mean ranks. We compare FOCUS with every ranked baseline at once. For each comparison we use the Wilcoxon signed-rank test with a Holm correction, and find FOCUS significantly ahead of all the baselines (Figure 2 ). Against the deep and TabPFN-based detectors, the closest to ours in spirit, FOCUS leads by a wide margin, and ZEN’s margin over every baseline is also positive and significant (Figure 3 ). Under AUPRC (Table 8 ) FOCUS keeps the best mean in both regimes; Appendix C.2 adds per-regime critical-difference diagrams and the complete pairwise matrix.
paragraphs.zh: 在干净数据场景下表现优异的方法，在存在污染时往往表现得更差。 表1展示了每种方法在两种场景下的列值分布模式。 最近邻检测器的表现最差：原始特征 k-NN 损失了 11 个 AUROC 分数，而 LOF 则损失了 17 分。 Isolation Forest 的退化程度要小得多，并成为了最强的基线方法。 我们的方法优于它。 ZEN（我们的无需训练版本）的平均 AUROC 高于所有基线方法，比 Isolation Forest 高出 3.3 分（p = 0.02）。 FOCUS 在 ZEN 的基础上进一步提升了 0.3 分，达到了所有方法中最高的平均 AUROC，比 Isolation Forest 高出 3.6 分（p = 0.01），比原始特征 k-NN 高出 6.1 分（p = 0.02）。 ZEN 和 FOCUS 还拥有最高的两个平均排名。 我们将 FOCUS 与所有经过排名的基线方法同时进行对比。 在每次比较中，我们使用威尔科克森符号秩检验并结合霍尔姆校正，发现 FOCUS 显著优于所有基线方法（图2）。 在与深度学习和 TabPFN 相关的检测器（其理念与我们的方法最为接近）的对比中，FOCUS 以较大优势领先；ZEN 相对于所有基线方法的领先幅度也均为正值且显著（图3）。 在 AUPRC 指标下（表8），FOCUS 在两种场景中都保持了最佳平均值；附录 C.2 补充了各场景的临界差异图以及完整的成对比较矩阵。

paragraphs.en: When the reference set contains no anomalies, the picture changes: raw-feature k k NN is the strongest baseline and sits well above every other baseline (Table 1 , clean columns). FOCUS and ZEN reach the two highest mean AUROCs, but k k NN keeps the best mean rank. paragraphs.en: In practice, it is often unknown how contaminated the training set is, if at all. A practitioner who chooses FOCUS without knowing whether the clean or the contaminated regime holds therefore matches the best classical detector if the reference set turns out clean, and gains 3.6 AUROC points over the best baseline if it does not.

paragraphs.en: We measure what each part of our method contributes, in the contaminated regime. The starting point is the plain readout : the frozen model’s embedding of the data, read by k k NN distance and nothing else (Sec. 2.2 ). Figure 4 a ablates ZEN’s three steps, one at a time (Appendix C.4 ablates every step in both regimes, with significance tests). The plain readout reaches 74.1 AUROC, next to raw-feature k k NN’s 73.9 and the best deep detector. The augmented context adds 0.9 points. The embedding with feature subsets adds 1.9 points. The soft cleaning adds 2.8 points, the largest step. Together the steps take the frozen model from 74.1 to 79.7, above every baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在受污染场景下衡量了我们方法中每个部分的贡献。 起点是朴素读取：通过 k 近邻距离读取冻结模型对数据的嵌入，仅此而已（第 2.2 节）。 图 4a 依次对 ZEN 的三个步骤进行了消融分析（附录 C.4 在两种场景下对每个步骤进行了消融分析，并附有显著性检验）。 朴素读取的 AUROC 达到 74.1，接近原始特征 k 近邻的 73.9 以及最佳深度检测器的水平。 增强上下文贡献了 0.9 分。 使用特征子集的嵌入贡献了 1.9 分。 软清洗贡献了 2.8 分，是最大的提升步骤。 这些步骤共同将冻结模型的得分从 74.1 提升至 79.7，超过了所有基线模型。

paragraphs.en: Density-based detectors rate a sample by how far it sits from its nearest reference samples. When the reference set holds undetected anomalies, a test anomaly that is similar to them finds close neighbors and appears normal. Figure 4 b shows the cost the contamination induces on each dataset: between the clean and the contaminated regime raw-feature k k NN loses 11 AUROC points on average, while FOCUS loses only 5.9 points.
paragraphs.zh: 基于密度的检测器通过样本与其最近参考样本之间的距离来评估该样本。 当参考集中包含未检测到的异常时，与之相似的测试异常会找到邻近的参考样本，从而显得正常。 图 4b 展示了污染对每个数据集造成的影响：在干净与受污染状态之间，原始特征 k-NN 平均损失了 11 个 AUROC 点，而 FOCUS 仅损失了 5.9 个点。

sents.en: Density-based detectors rate a sample by how far it sits from its nearest reference samples.
sents.zh: 基于密度的检测器通过样本与其最近参考样本之间的距离来评估该样本。

sents.en: When the reference set holds undetected anomalies, a test anomaly that is similar to them finds close neighbors and appears normal.
sents.zh: 当参考集中包含未检测到的异常时，与之相似的测试异常会找到邻近的参考样本，从而显得正常。

sents.zh: 图 4b 展示了污染对每个数据集造成的影响：在干净与受污染状态之间，原始特征 k-NN 平均损失了 11 个 AUROC 点，而 FOCUS 仅损失了 5.9 个点。

paragraphs.en: FOCUS limits the damage from contamination by finding the anomalies hiding in the reference set and preventing them from “hiding" the test anomalies. Its isolation estimate scores every reference sample by how far it sits from its nearest other reference samples. Used as an anomaly score for the reference samples, the estimate reaches 76.7 AUROC (Appendix C.4 , Figure 9 ). The multi-subset averaging is essential here. It works because the runs use different features, and therefore make different mistakes during soft cleaning. The trust weights built from the pooled estimate average 0.70 on a reference anomaly and 1.16 on a normal sample, so a test anomaly next to a reference anomaly no longer looks normal. Appendix C.4 gives the full breakdown.
paragraphs.zh: FOCUS 通过发现参考集中隐藏的异常，并防止它们“掩盖”测试异常，从而限制污染造成的损害。 其隔离估计值根据每个参考样本与其最近的其他参考样本之间的距离，对每个样本进行评分。 该估计值被用作参考样本的异常分数，达到了 76.7 AUROC（附录 C.4，图 9）。 在此过程中，多子集平均法是必不可少的。 之所以有效，是因为每次运行使用了不同的特征，因此在软清洗过程中会犯出不同的错误。 基于合并估计值构建的信任权重在参考异常上平均为 0.70，在正常样本上平均为 1.16，因此位于参考异常旁边的测试异常不再看起来正常。 附录 C.4 提供了完整的详细分析。

paragraphs.en: Classical tabular anomaly detection comes from several algorithm families ( Zhao et al., 2019 ; Han et al., 2022 ) . Neighborhood and local-density methods score samples relative to nearby reference points. kNN uses distance to neighboring samples, while LOF compares the local density of a sample with that of its neighbors ( Breunig et al., 2000 ) . Partitioning, projection, and ensemble methods avoid explicit local-density estimation. Isolation Forest isolates anomalies through recursive random partitions ( Liu et al., 2008 ) , LODA aggregates weak detectors built on random one-dimensional projections ( Pevnỳ, 2016 ) , and feature bagging combines detectors across random feature subsets ( Lazarevic and Kumar, 2005 ) . ZEN’s feature subsets are closest to this last idea, though each subset changes the in-context representation itself. Distributional and support-estimation methods model the normal region more directly. HBOS estimates feature-wise densities using histograms ( Goldstein and Dengel, 2012 ) , COPOD scores samples by their extremeness in the tails of empirical distributions ( Li et al., 2020 ) , and one-class SVM estimates the support of the data in a kernel feature space ( Schölkopf et al., 2001 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 经典的表格型异常检测方法源自多种算法家族（Zhao 等人，2019；Han 等人，2022）。 邻域和局部密度方法通过参考邻近的参照点来为样本打分。kNN 使用与邻近样本的距离进行判断，而 LOF 则比较某个样本的局部密度与其邻近样本的局部密度（Breunig 等人，2000）。 分区、投影和集成方法避免了显式的局部密度估计。 Isolation Forest 通过递归随机分区来隔离异常（Liu 等人，2008），LODA 聚合基于随机一维投影构建的弱检测器（Pevnỳ，2016），而特征袋装法则结合来自随机特征子集的多个检测器（Lazarevic 和 Kumar，2005）。 ZEN 的特征子集与最后一种方法最为接近，尽管每个子集都会改变上下文表示本身。 分布和支撑估计方法更直接地对正常区域进行建模。 HBOS 使用直方图来估计各特征的密度（Goldstein 和 Dengel，2012），COPOD 根据样本在经验分布尾部的极端性进行打分（Li 等人，2020），而单类 SVM 则在核特征空间中估计数据的支撑域（Schölkopf 等人，2001）。

paragraphs.en: An early self-supervised line of works brought transformation-based objectives to tabular data: GOAD classifies random affine transformations of the data ( Bergman and Hoshen, 2020 ) ; NeuTraL AD learns the transformations themselves ( Qiu et al., 2021 ) ; ICL trains with an internal contrastive objective ( Shenkar and Wolf, 2022 ) . DTE estimates the diffusion time of a sample and scores it accordingly ( Livernoche et al., 2024 ) . TCCM learns a flow-matching-style contraction field and scores by the deviation at one time step ( Li et al., 2025 ) . MCM scores by masked cell modeling ( Yin et al., 2024 ) . NPT-AD reconstructs masked features using a non-parametric transformer that alternates attention across features within each sample and attention across samples ( Thimonier et al., 2024 ) . Noise-evaluation methods learn to separate the data from artificially corrupted copies of it ( Dai et al., 2025 ) . DeepSVDD introduced the fixed-center compactness objective FOCUS builds on ( Ruff et al., 2018 ) . All of these methods pay a per-dataset training cost; in our pipeline the only training anywhere is FOCUS’s two-epoch fine-tune.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的自监督研究系列将基于变换的目标引入表格数据：GOAD 对数据的随机仿射变换进行分类（Bergman 和 Hoshen，2020）；NeuTraL AD 学习变换本身（Qiu 等，2021）；ICL 则通过内部对比目标进行训练（Shenkar 和 Wolf，2022）。 DTE 估计样本的扩散时间并据此打分（Livernoche 等，2024）。 TCCM 学习一种流匹配风格的收缩场，并通过单一时间步上的偏差进行评分（Li 等，2025）。 MCM 通过掩码单元格建模进行评分（Yin 等，2024）。 NPT-AD 使用一个非参数化转换器重建被掩码的特征，该转换器在每个样本内部交替对特征进行注意力计算，并在不同样本间交替进行注意力计算（Thimonier 等，2024）。 噪声评估方法学习将数据与其人为破坏的副本区分开来（Dai 等，2025）。 DeepSVDD 引入了固定中心紧凑性目标，FOCUS 正是基于这一目标构建的（Ruff 等，2018）。 所有这些方法都需要为每个数据集支付训练成本；而在我们的流程中，唯一存在的训练环节是 FOCUS 的两轮微调。

paragraphs.en: A recent line of work pretrains dedicated detectors once and applies them to new datasets without further training: TACTIC ( Marszałek et al., 2026 ) and FoMo-0D ( Shen et al., 2025 ) are pretrained on synthetic anomaly-detection tasks for zero-shot detection. OutFormer ( Ding et al., 2026 ) is pretrained on synthetic labeled datasets and infers test labels in context. OFA-TAD ( Li et al., 2026 ) trains once on multiple source datasets to generalize to unseen ones. These detectors commit to their anomaly assumptions at pretraining time. Frozen TabPFN has also served as a plug-in scorer: the official unsupervised extension scores anomalies through the library’s density construction over the frozen model ( Prior Labs, 2025 ) , and OutFormer’s appendix builds a similar frozen TabPFN baseline ( Ding et al., 2026 ) . We differ from these prior attempts to use PFNs for anomaly detection: ZEN uses the embeddings of a pretrained classification model rather than its predictions, and FOCUS adapts them.

paragraphs.en: In images, k k NN on frozen pretrained features outperformed earlier self-supervised detectors ( Bergman et al., 2020 ) . Anomaly localization methods were built on the same kind of features ( Cohen and Hoshen, 2020 ; Roth et al., 2022 ) . PANDA, MSAD, and Transformaly adapt the pretrained features to the normal training data ( Reiss et al., 2021 ; Reiss and Hoshen, 2023 ; Cohen and Avidan, 2022 ) . paragraphs.en: Scoring with ZEN or FOCUS runs TabPFN forward passes for each of the B + 1 = 6 B{+}1=6 feature subsets. Both therefore need a GPU: on one A100, our method processes 3,500 samples per minute (Appendix D.3 ). Although this is slower than many classical detectors, most of that time is taken by the forward passes themselves, with ten leave-one-fold-out passes per feature subset ( Ye et al., 2025 ) . This cost can be cut in several ways. Fewer leave-one-fold-out folds cost nothing measurable and can substantially reduce computation time (Appendix C.8 ), and fewer feature subsets trade marginal accuracy for a significant speedup (Appendix C.6 ). Every speedup of the backbone’s forward pass, such as the reduced KV cache of the TabPFN-3 report ( Grinsztajn et al., 2026 ) , lowers our cost directly.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 ZEN 或 FOCUS 进行评分时，会对每个 B + 1 = 6 个特征子集执行 TabPFN 的前向传播。 因此，两者都需要 GPU：在一块 A100 上，我们的方法每分钟可处理 3,500 个样本（附录 D.3）。 尽管这比许多经典检测器慢，但大部分时间消耗在前向传播本身，每个特征子集需要进行十次“留一折”前向传播（Ye et al., 2025）。 这种成本可以通过多种方式进行削减。 减少“留一折”的折数不会带来可测量的额外成本，并能显著缩短计算时间（附录 C.8）；而减少特征子集的数量则以牺牲少量准确性为代价，换取显著的速度提升（附录 C.6）。 任何对主干网络前向传播的加速，例如 TabPFN-3 报告中提到的简化 KV 缓存（Grinsztajn et al., 2026），都能直接降低我们的成本。

paragraphs.en: ADBench’s standard evaluation subsamples datasets above 10,000 10{,}000 samples (Sec. 3.1 ), so the largest reference set our methods have seen holds 10,000 10{,}000 samples. Every score is a set of TabPFN forward passes over the whole reference set, so the cost grows with its size, and larger sets are untested. Yet, TabPFN-3 handles up to one million samples ( Grinsztajn et al., 2026 ) , and future models will likely accommodate even more. Learned contexts ( Feuer et al., 2024 ) and test-time adaptations ( Ye et al., 2025 ) , are emerging options to extend the same methods to larger tables. paragraphs.en: In this paper we show that pretrained PFNs, once adapted to the task, make a strong anomaly detector. Our approach first embeds the data with the frozen model on random feature subsets and softly cleans the reference set. Under contamination it already reaches a higher mean AUROC than every classical and deep baseline in our comparison. FOCUS, our trust-weighted compactness fine-tune, reaches the highest mean AUROC in both clean and contaminated regimes and is significantly ahead of every baseline in the contaminated regime.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们证明了预先训练的 PFN 一旦适应特定任务，就能成为强大的异常检测器。 我们的方法首先使用冻结模型在随机特征子集上对数据进行嵌入，并对参考集进行软性清洗。 在存在污染的情况下，它已经比我们所比较的所有经典和深度基准模型达到了更高的平均 AUROC。 FOCUS（我们的信任加权紧凑性微调方法）在干净和受污染两种情况下都实现了最高的平均 AUROC，并且在受污染情况下显著优于所有基准模型。

paragraphs.en: For the PFN community our results are evidence that in-context representations carry well beyond their pretraining objective. We also show that our method of extracting meaningful representations for anomaly detection, applied without any tuning or change, significantly improves four other tabular foundation models as well. None of the examined models was pretrained for anomaly detection, yet all of them exhibited strong anomaly-detection capabilities when adapted appropriately. This suggests that such capabilities are broadly accessible across in-context tabular models, even for tasks that were never used for pretraining.

paragraphs.en: This work uses only publicly available, anonymized benchmark datasets and involves no human subjects or personally identifiable information. The contribution is methodological. paragraphs.en: ADBench’s official generator resamples every dataset below 1,000 1{,}000 samples to exactly 1,000 1{,}000 by drawing samples with replacement, before the train/test split ( Han et al., 2022 ) . Copies of one physical sample can therefore land on both sides of the split. Twelve of the 47 datasets are affected. Table 2 reports, for each of them, the fraction of test samples whose byte-identical twin sits in the training set under that protocol, measured by replicating the official code path on the real data over seeds 0–4. Natural duplicate samples in the raw data are not counted; without the resampling step the fraction is structurally zero. In the contaminated regime, on average 88.5 % 88.5\% of all test samples have a training twin. In the clean regime the training set is normal-only, so anomalies cannot leak; instead 91.5 % 91.5\% of the test normal samples have one. For a distance- or density-based scorer a twin sits at distance zero, which drives the affected normal test scores toward their minimum and widens the apparent normal/anomaly separation. The inflation therefore acts upward on exactly the detector families these benchmarks rank.
paragraphs.zh: ADBench 的官方生成器会在训练集/测试集划分之前，通过有放回抽样将每个样本数低于 1,000 的数据集重新采样至恰好 1,000 个样本（Han et al., 2022）。 因此，同一物理样本的副本可能会出现在划分的两侧。 47 个数据集中有 12 个受到影响。 表 2 报告了每个数据集在此协议下受影响测试样本的比例：这些样本在字节层面与其孪生样本位于训练集中；该比例通过在真实数据上以种子值 0–4 重复执行官方代码路径进行测量。 原始数据中天然存在的重复样本不计入统计；若没有重新采样步骤，该比例在结构上为零。 在受污染的情况下，平均有 88.5% 的测试样本在训练集中存在孪生样本。 在干净的情况下，训练集仅包含正常样本，因此异常值不会泄露；相反，91.5% 的正常测试样本在训练集中存在孪生样本。 对于基于距离或密度的评分器，孪生样本的距离为零，这会使受影响的正常测试得分趋近其最小值，并扩大表观上的正常/异常分离度。 因此，这种虚增效应恰好作用于这些基准测试所排名的检测器类别。

paragraphs.en: TabPFN-3 is characterized up to 200 input features ( Grinsztajn et al., 2026 ) , and past that the library switches to an internal ensemble of estimators. Our fine-tuning implementation trains a single shared module, so that ensemble would multiply the cost and break the design. On the three datasets with more than 200 features (census, InternetAds, speech), ZEN and FOCUS therefore use a fixed subset of 200 features, drawn once with constant features excluded; every other method uses every feature. uTabPFN builds its density one feature at a time, so its cost grows with the feature count. On the same three datasets a single seed takes about five to seven GPU-hours, and we did not run all five. Its aggregates therefore cover 44 of 47 datasets, marked wherever they appear. Four PyOD detectors (COPOD, ECOD, SOD, and COF) compute part of their statistics over the batch being scored, which is how the library and ADBench run them; every other method, ours included, scores each test sample from training-set state alone. CBLOF fails on a small number of seeds when its clustering cannot separate the data; its dataset means average the completed seeds.
paragraphs.zh: TabPFN-3 最多支持 200 个输入特征（Grinsztajn 等人，2026），超过该数量后，该库会切换到内部集成估计器。 我们的微调实现仅训练一个共享模块，因此使用集成方法会增加成本并破坏原有设计。 在包含超过 200 个特征的三个数据集（人口普查、互联网广告和语音数据）上，ZEN 和 FOCUS 因此使用一个固定的 200 特征子集，该子集在一次抽取中确定且排除固定特征；所有其他方法（包括我们的方法）都会使用全部特征。uTabPFN 每次仅构建一个特征对应的密度，因此其成本随特征数量增加而增长。 在这三个相同的数据集上，单个种子运行大约需要五到七 GPU 小时，而我们并未运行全部五个种子。 因此，其聚合结果覆盖了 47 个数据集中的 44 个，并在相应位置进行了标记。 四个 PyOD 检测器（COPOD、ECOD、SOD 和 COF）在计算部分统计量时会使用正在评分的批次数据，这也是该库和 ADBench 运行它们的方式；所有其他方法（包括我们的方法）仅基于训练集的状态对每个测试样本进行评分。 当聚类无法区分数据时，CBLOF 会在少数种子上失效；其数据集均值是对成功完成的种子进行平均得到的。

paragraphs.en: Table 8 reports each method’s mean AUPRC (average precision, × 100 \times 100 ) and its mean per-dataset AUPRC rank. AUPRC depends strongly on the test anomaly rate, which spans 0.03 % 0.03\% to 39.9 % 39.9\% across the contaminated regime’s datasets (Table 3 ) and runs higher still in the clean regime, whose test sets hold every anomaly. A cross-dataset mean therefore weights datasets very unevenly, and the rank column is the more comparable summary. Every value is computed from stored score vectors, and a method’s AUPRC is reported only where those vectors reproduce the method’s official AUROC. FOCUS has the best mean AUPRC in both regimes and the best mean rank under contamination. Its contaminated lead over Isolation Forest is not significant ( p = 0.08 p=0.08 ), while its lead over raw-feature k k NN is ( p = 0.002 p=0.002 ). paragraphs.en: Figure 2 compares FOCUS with the baselines in the contaminated regime, following the procedure of Demšar (2006) for comparing one proposed method with several others. Methods are ranked within each dataset on their five-seed mean AUROC, rank 1 the best, and the axis of the figure is the mean rank over the 47 datasets. The ranked pool holds FOCUS and the 16 baselines that cover all 47 datasets; uTabPFN covers 44. ZEN, our own frozen detector, is not a baseline; its comparison with FOCUS is in Sec. 3 . A Friedman test over the 17 methods rejects the hypothesis that all perform alike ( p < 10 − 13 p<10^{-13} ). FOCUS is then tested against each of the 16 baselines with a two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test on the 47 paired values ( Benavoli et al., 2016 ) , and the 16 p p -values are Holm-corrected. All 16 are significant; the largest Holm-adjusted p p -value is 0.034 0.034 , against raw-feature k k NN and TabPFN-PL. The bars among the baselines are critical-difference cliques: Wilcoxon tests over all 120 of their pairs, Holm-corrected, with a bar joining each maximal run of adjacent methods among which no pair differs significantly. Against uTabPFN, on its 44 datasets, FOCUS is ahead by 13.1 AUROC points ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). FOCUS beats Isolation Forest on 28 of the 47 datasets; the signed-rank test weighs the size of each difference, and FOCUS’s wins are the larger ones.

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 shows how far each method trails the per-dataset best across the 47 datasets. On each dataset, a method’s regret is the AUROC of the best compared method on that dataset minus its own. The profile plots, for every tolerance τ \tau , the fraction of datasets on which the method’s regret is at most τ \tau ; a curve that rises faster belongs to a method that is rarely far from the best. Compared with an oracle that picks the best method for each dataset, FOCUS trails by 4.3 AUROC points on average and ZEN by 4.6, the two smallest gaps in the comparison. The largest gaps appear in two situations. On shuttle, Cardiotocography, vertebral and pendigits, four datasets with at most 21 features, Isolation Forest is well ahead of our detectors. On Wilt, the point above the diagonal in Figure 4 b, the reference anomalies do not look isolated to the estimate, so the cleaning misfires and costs 6 AUROC points; over all 47 datasets the cleaning helps by more than one AUROC point on 27 and costs more than one point on 10. On Speech no method in the comparison, ours included, reaches 55 AUROC in either regime; vertebral and yeast are the only other such datasets. Speech’s features are nearly Gaussian, so the challenge there is the representation itself, and semantic context in the spirit of ReTabAD ( Yoon et al., 2026 ) is a promising complement.

paragraphs.en: Table 10 lists the ladder of Figure 4 a for both regimes and both models, recomputed on CPU from the official run’s saved embeddings with the official constants; the last step reproduces the ZEN and FOCUS means of the main runs to within 0.05 AUROC (half-precision storage). Each step is compared with the previous one by a Wilcoxon signed-rank test over the 47 dataset means, and Figure 8 plots the difference between the two models at each step, the fine-tune’s gain, in both regimes. The extra line of each contaminated block cleans every one of the 24 representations with its own weights instead of the pooled ones; Appendix C.6 varies every constant of the readout on the same runs. The isolation estimate of Sec. 2.2 ranks the reference samples of each contaminated run (Figure 9 ); against the reference labels, one plain embedding scores 73.9 AUROC, the average single representation (one feature subset, one block) 71.9, the full set of features pooled over its four blocks 74.6, the twenty random-subset representations pooled 76.2, and all 24 pooled 76.7. The pooled estimate beats the single representations on 43 of the 47 datasets ( p < 10 − 10 p<10^{-10} ). paragraphs.en: The readout takes the embeddings of the last four of TabPFN-3’s 24 transformer blocks (Sec. 2.2 ). Table 11 and Figure 10 vary this choice on the same datasets, seeds and splits as the main results, in both regimes, for the frozen model (ZEN) and the adapted one (FOCUS): the last n n blocks for n n from 1 to 24, three four-block windows deeper in the network, and, in the figure, every single block. The four-block window reproduces the official means to within 0.05 AUROC in every case. paragraphs.en: Table 13 varies the constants of the fine-tune: the number K K of trainable blocks, the trust weights of Eq. 6 , the number of epochs, the checkpoint rule and the learning rate. These arms rerun the fine-tune, so they are run at one seed (seed 0) on every dataset, on the mixed GPU types of our cluster’s spare nodes. The frozen readout itself differs between GPU types by up to a few AUROC points on the smallest datasets, so the paper’s own setting is rerun under the same conditions and every arm is compared with that rerun, paired over the 47 datasets; the rerun reproduces the official seed-0 means to within 0.05 AUROC in both regimes. Under contamination K = 3 K=3 and the paper’s K = 6 K=6 are equivalent ( − 0.5 -0.5 , p = 0.91 p=0.91 ) and deeper fine-tunes are worse, by 2.6 points at K = 12 K=12 and 3.2 at K = 24 K=24 , both significant. On clean data the paper’s K = 12 K=12 is best, K = 3 K=3 is within 0.5 points (not significant), K = 6 K=6 costs 1.0 ( p = 0.04 p=0.04 ) and K = 24 K=24 costs 3.0. paragraphs.en: Table 15 and Figure 12 report the plain readout and ZEN on five backbones in both regimes: TabPFN-3, the paper’s backbone; TabPFN v2 ( Hollmann et al., 2025 ) ; TabICL ( Qu et al., 2025 ) , in its TabICLv2 checkpoint ( Qu et al., 2026 ) ; TabDPT ( Ma et al., 2025 ) ; and Mitra ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Every constant of Sec. 2.2 and Appendix D.1 is unchanged, and every model runs frozen with the full reference set as its context, a single estimator and its test-time augmentations switched off. The one rule applied per backbone is where the embeddings are taken: the last four blocks of the model’s in-context transformer, at the point where the model itself uses its last block. These are blocks 20–23 of 24 for TabPFN-3, 8–11 of 12 for TabPFN v2, TabICL and Mitra, and 28–31 of 32 for TabDPT. Each block’s output passes through the model’s own final normalization where the model has one; TabDPT’s running representation is taken directly, and Mitra’s at the label slot of each query sample. We check on every run that the captured last block reproduces the model’s own output, to within 0.02 in predicted probability. TabDPT accepts at most 128 features, so on the five datasets with more features each run uses a fixed random subset of 128 of them, the same device as the paper’s 200-feature cap. Every run used the same GPU model and the paper’s five seeds. The TabPFN-3 arm reproduces the paper’s ZEN on every dataset to within 0.5 AUROC, and raw-feature k k NN, which needs no forward pass, reproduces the paper’s values exactly.

paragraphs.en: Under contamination ZEN’s steps help on every backbone, with the largest gain on the weakest one. In the clean regime the soft cleaning is switched off and only the feature subsets and the augmented context act; the gain is then smaller, significant for TabPFN-3, TabPFN v2, TabICL and Mitra, and not for TabDPT (0.6 AUROC points, p = 0.36 p=0.36 ). Between backbones, TabPFN-3 leads TabPFN v2 significantly in both regimes (by 4.2 and 5.3 AUROC points); its leads over TabICL (0.8, p = 0.13 p=0.13 ; 0.3, p = 0.88 p=0.88 ) and over TabDPT (0.7, p = 0.26 p=0.26 ; 0.0, p = 0.78 p=0.78 ) are not significant. Its lead over Mitra is significant under contamination (3.4, p = 0.006 p=0.006 ) and not on clean data (1.0, p = 0.24 p=0.24 ); Mitra in turn leads TabPFN v2 significantly on clean data (4.3, p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) but not under contamination (0.8, p = 0.28 p=0.28 ). On clean data TabPFN-3 (85.2) and TabDPT (85.2) reach raw-feature k k NN (85.1), TabICL (84.9) and Mitra (84.2) stay just below it, and TabPFN v2 (79.9) well below.
paragraphs.zh: 在污染情况下，ZEN 的各个步骤对每个骨干模型都有帮助，其中对最弱的骨干模型增益最大。 在干净数据场景下，软清洗功能被禁用，仅特征子集和增强上下文发挥作用；此时增益较小，TabPFN-3、TabPFN v2、TabICL 和 Mitra 的增益显著，而 TabDPT 则不然（0.6 AUROC 点，p = 0.36 p=0.36）。 在不同骨干模型之间，TabPFN-3 在两种场景下均显著优于 TabPFN v2（分别高出 4.2 和 5.3 AUROC 点）；但它对 TabICL（0.8，p = 0.13 p=0.13；0.3，p = 0.88 p=0.88）和 TabDPT（0.7，p = 0.26 p=0.26；0.0，p = 0.78 p=0.78）的优势并不显著。 在污染情况下，TabPFN-3 对 Mitra 的优势显著（3.4，p = 0.006 p=0.006），但在干净数据中则不显著（1.0，p = 0.24 p=0.24）；而 Mitra 在干净数据中显著优于 TabPFN v2（4.3，p < 0.001 p<0.001），但在污染情况下则不然（0.8，p = 0.28 p=0.28）。 在干净数据中，TabPFN-3（85.2）和 TabDPT（85.2）达到了原始特征 k k NN 模型的水平（85.1），TabICL（84.9）和 Mitra（84.2）略低于该水平，而 TabPFN v2（79.9）则明显落后。

paragraphs.en: The fine-tune was also run on TabPFN v2 under contamination, with the contaminated regime’s constants unchanged ( K = 6 K=6 of its 12 blocks) and the paper’s five seeds. Three datasets (backdoor, census and speech) exceed the memory of our largest GPU on this arm and are left out, so the arm covers 44 datasets. There the fine-tune lifts the plain readout from 67.6 to 70.7 AUROC ( + 3.0 +3.0 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 , 31 of 44 datasets), against + 2.0 +2.0 ( p = 0.002 p=0.002 ) on TabPFN-3 in the same run, and FOCUS reaches 76.1 AUROC, above ZEN’s 75.9 on the same datasets: as on TabPFN-3, the fine-tune’s gain is large on the plain readout and small once ZEN’s steps are in place (Sec. 4 ). This arm ran on other GPU types than the runs of Table 15 ; the TabPFN-3 arm of the same run, on the paper’s GPU type, reproduces the paper’s FOCUS to within 0.05 AUROC.
paragraphs.zh: 在污染条件下，该微调也在 TabPFN v2 上运行，其中受污染机制的常数保持不变（其 12 个区块中的 K = 6），并使用了论文中指定的五个种子。 三个数据集（后门、人口普查和语音）超出了本分支中我们最大 GPU 的内存容量，因此被排除在外，所以该分支共涵盖 44 个数据集。 在此处，微调将普通读出方法的 AUROC 从 67.6 提升至 70.7（+3.0，p < 0.001，44 个数据集中有 31 个），而在同一运行中，TabPFN-3 的提升仅为 +2.0（p = 0.002）；FOCUS 的 AUROC 达到了 76.1，超过了 ZEN 在同一数据集上的 75.9。与 TabPFN-3 的情况一样，微调在普通读出方法上带来了显著增益，但在引入 ZEN 的步骤后，增益则变得很小（第 4 节）。 该分支运行于不同于表 15 中运行的其他 GPU 类型；而同一运行中基于论文所用 GPU 类型的 TabPFN-3 分支，其 FOCUS 结果与论文中的结果在 0.05 AUROC 范围内一致。

paragraphs.en: TabPFN expects labeled context samples and anomaly detection provides none, so each run passes fixed arbitrary labels: a random 0/1 vector drawn once from the run’s seed. The labels carry no information about which samples are anomalous, and the readout never uses the classifier head. Reference-set embeddings are extracted leave-one-fold-out with ten folds, following Ye et al. (2025) : each fold is embedded in the query role against the remaining folds, so training and test embeddings come from the same code path in the same role. When the reference set holds fewer than ten samples, the fold count drops to that number, never below two. Each extraction uses a single estimator for determinism.
paragraphs.zh: TabPFN 需要带标签的上下文样本，而异常检测并未提供这些样本，因此每次运行都会传入固定的任意标签：即根据该次运行的种子一次性抽取的随机 0/1 向量。这些标签不包含任何关于哪些样本是异常的信息，且读取过程也从未使用分类器头。参考集嵌入采用“留一折”（leave-one-fold-out）方法提取，共十折，遵循 Ye et al. (2025) 的做法：每一折都在查询角色中与其他剩余折进行比较，因此训练和测试嵌入均来自同一角色中的相同代码路径。当参考集中的样本数少于十个时，折数会降至该样本数量，但绝不会低于二。每次提取均使用单个估计器以确保确定性。

paragraphs.en: The B B random feature subsets hold max ⁡ ( 2 , round ⁡ ( d / 2 ) ) \max(2,\mathrm{round}(d/2)) features each, drawn without replacement once per dataset and seed. Random feature subsets are the device behind random forests ( Breiman, 2001 ) and feature-bagging outlier ensembles ( Lazarevic and Kumar, 2005 ) , and the motivation is the same here: runs that make different mistakes average out one another’s errors (Sec. 5 ). A run’s context is its feature subset of the reference set plus m = min ⁡ ( n , 500 ) m=\min(n,500) synthetic samples drawn uniformly on [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] over its features, with the same kind of arbitrary labels as the reference samples. The synthetic samples are never scored and never serve as neighbors; they only change what the model conditions on when it embeds the real samples, and they stay in every fold’s context. Figure 4 a, Appendix C.4 and Appendix C.8 show their effect.

paragraphs.en: ADBench benchmarks 14 unsupervised detectors, 13 of them through PyOD. DAGMM is the exception: ADBench ships its own implementation. We run 12 of the 13 PyOD detectors and leave DAGMM out rather than port a second implementation of one legacy baseline. PyOD’s k k NN is replaced by raw-feature k k NN, the same algorithm scored by the mean distance to its k = 20 k{=}20 nearest neighbors (Appendix D.1 ) rather than the library default, the distance to the fifth neighbor. All PyOD detectors run at library defaults with contamination = 0.1 {}=0.1 , matching how ADBench itself instantiates them ( Han et al., 2022 ) , which likewise runs every detector at its default hyperparameters rather than tuning on a labeled hold-out set. Such tuning is not available to a label-free practitioner in any case, so no method is tuned per dataset (Sec. 3 ). The one deviation from the defaults is PCA’s component count. At the default the detector keeps every component, and on three (dataset, seed) pairs the training covariance is singular, which makes the resulting scores infinite. We therefore cap the count at 95% cumulative explained variance, a standard sklearn idiom, uniformly on every dataset.
paragraphs.zh: ADBench 对 14 种无监督检测器进行了基准测试，其中 13 种是通过 PyOD 实现的。 DAGMM 是个例外：ADBench 自带其自身的实现版本。 我们对 13 种 PyOD 检测器中的 12 种进行了运行，并排除了 DAGMM，而不是为某个旧版基线模型移植第二个实现版本。 PyOD 的 k k NN 被替换为原始特征 k k NN，即使用到其 k = 20 k{=}20 个最近邻的平均距离作为评分标准（附录 D.1），而非该库默认的第五个邻居的距离。 所有 PyOD 检测器均按照库的默认设置运行，其中 contamination = 0.1 {}=0.1，这与 ADBench 自身实例化它们的方式一致（Han et al., 2022）；ADBench 同样以每个检测器的默认超参数运行，而不是在带标签的预留数据集上进行调优。 无论如何，没有标签的实践者都无法进行此类调优，因此没有任何方法会针对特定数据集进行调优（第 3 节）。 唯一偏离默认设置的是 PCA 的成分数量。 在默认设置下，该检测器会保留所有成分；但在三组（数据集、随机种子）中，训练协方差矩阵是奇异的，这会导致最终的评分值变为无穷大。 因此，我们将成分数量限制在累积解释方差达到 95% 的阈值上，这是 sklearn 的标准做法，并且对所有数据集统一执行。

paragraphs.en: The added baselines run as their authors specify. TCCM trains one model per dataset with its authors’ architecture and training protocol; its per-dataset epoch count and batch size come from the fixed table their code ships, one entry per dataset, unchanged across seeds. The per-seed score vectors of its contaminated-regime run were not retained, only the per-dataset AUROC means, so its contaminated AUPRC is withheld in Table 8 . It reads the shared MinMax [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] features like every other method rather than its own z-scoring default. DTE runs in its categorical variant at the authors’ recommended hyperparameters. The TabPFN pseudo-labeling control flags the 10% of training samples a PCA detector scores as most anomalous, fits TabPFN’s classifier on those pseudo-labels, and scores each test sample by its predicted anomaly probability. The official unsupervised TabPFN extension (uTabPFN) runs through its public API; its per-feature density construction is what makes it infeasible on the three widest datasets (App. A.3 ). The pretrained anomaly detectors of Sec. 5 (TACTIC, FoMo-0D, OutFormer, OFA-TAD) are not run: this paper asks what a general-purpose tabular model gives anomaly detection, so every compared method starts without anomaly-specific pretraining.

sents.zh: 该探测未涵盖 TCCM、DTE、uTabPFN 或 TabPFN-PL。

paragraphs.en: We record the design alternatives we tried and rejected. Each was evaluated under the paper’s protocol in the contaminated regime and improved on nothing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们记录了所尝试并否决的设计方案。 每个方案都在该论文的受污染机制协议下进行了评估，但没有任何改进。

sents.en: We record the design alternatives we tried and rejected.
sents.zh: 我们记录了所尝试并否决的设计方案。

sents.en: Each was evaluated under the paper’s protocol in the contaminated regime and improved on nothing.
sents.zh: 每个方案都在该论文的受污染机制协议下进行了评估，但没有任何改进。

paragraphs.en: LOF scoring instead of k k NN distance. Local-density normalization loses to plain k k NN distance, on raw features and on our embeddings. Several datasets contain enough exact duplicate samples to break LOF’s reachability normalization, and a de-duplicated variant did not close the gap.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 LOF 评分而非 k k NN 距离。 在原始特征和我们的嵌入表示上，局部密度归一化都输给了普通的 k k NN 距离。 多个数据集包含足够多的完全重复样本，足以破坏 LOF 的可达性归一化，而经过去重处理的版本也未能缩小这一差距。

paragraphs.en: Hubness correction. Rescaling the embedding distances by mutual proximity is worse than the plain distance.
paragraphs.zh: Hubness 校正。 通过相互邻近性重新缩放嵌入距离的效果比直接使用原始距离更差。

sents.zh: 通过相互邻近性重新缩放嵌入距离的效果比直接使用原始距离更差。

paragraphs.en: Whitened and Mahalanobis-style k k NN. Not significantly better than plain k k NN in either regime.
paragraphs.zh: 经过白化处理的 Mahalanobis 风格 k k NN。 在两种情况下，效果都不显著优于普通的 k k NN。

sents.en: Whitened and Mahalanobis-style k k NN.
sents.zh: 经过白化处理的 Mahalanobis 风格 k k NN。

sents.zh: 在两种情况下，效果都不显著优于普通的 k k NN。

paragraphs.en: Distance to the center as the score. The training objective itself, read directly as an anomaly score, is far worse than the k k NN readout in both regimes.
paragraphs.zh: 以到中心的距离作为得分。 训练目标本身直接解读为异常分数，在两种情况下都远不如 k k NN 的读出结果。

paragraphs.en: Bagging the reference set. Averaging the readout over random subsets of the reference set, instead of over feature subsets, brings nothing.
paragraphs.zh: 获取参考集。 对参考集的随机子集进行读数平均，而不是对特征子集进行平均，并不会带来任何效果。

sents.en: Bagging the reference set.
sents.zh: 获取参考集。

sents.en: Averaging the readout over random subsets of the reference set, instead of over feature subsets, brings nothing.
sents.zh: 对参考集的随机子集进行读数平均，而不是对特征子集进行平均，并不会带来任何效果。

paragraphs.en: Other ways to pool the isolation estimate. Weighting feature subsets by their agreement, pessimistic pooling, calibrating the subsets to a common scale, and pooling over two neighborhood sizes all fail to improve on the plain mean of Sec. 2.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 估算隔离度的其他方法。 根据特征子集的一致性进行加权、采用悲观合并、将子集校准到统一标度，以及对两种邻域大小进行合并，这些方法都无法超越第 2.2 节中的简单平均值。

sents.en: Weighting feature subsets by their agreement, pessimistic pooling, calibrating the subsets to a common scale, and pooling over two neighborhood sizes all fail to improve on the plain mean of Sec. 2.2 .
sents.zh: 根据特征子集的一致性进行加权、采用悲观合并、将子集校准到统一标度，以及对两种邻域大小进行合并，这些方法都无法超越第 2.2 节中的简单平均值。

paragraphs.en: The classifier head. TabPFN’s predicted class probability under the arbitrary context labels is at chance as an anomaly score, and mixing it into the embedding score hurts.
paragraphs.zh: 分类器头。 在任意上下文标签下，TabPFN 预测的类别概率作为异常分数时仅处于随机水平，将其与嵌入分数混合会适得其反。

sents.en: The classifier head.
sents.zh: 分类器头。

sents.en: TabPFN’s predicted class probability under the arbitrary context labels is at chance as an anomaly score, and mixing it into the embedding score hurts.
sents.zh: 在任意上下文标签下，TabPFN 预测的类别概率作为异常分数时仅处于随机水平，将其与嵌入分数混合会适得其反。

paragraphs.en: Variants of the fine-tune. Fine-tuning each feature subset separately, fine-tuning through the augmented context, using the pooled isolation estimate as the fine-tune’s trust weights, and contracting each reference sample toward a local center instead of one global center bring no gain.
paragraphs.zh: 微调的变体。 分别对每个特征子集进行微调、通过增强上下文进行微调、使用池化隔离估计值作为微调的信任权重，以及将每个参考样本向局部中心而非单一全局中心收缩，均未带来任何增益。
